statement.zh: 社科院考古所《小屯南地甲骨》（1980–1983）正式著录 1973 年小屯南地甲骨。
statement.en: CASS Oracle Bones from the South of Xiaotun (1980–1983) formally publishes the 1973 Xiaotunnan oracle bones.
